items.title: Conversation loading
items.description: Conversations open after routine server updates without needing a matching Chat release. Chat loads the selected session directly and reports errors from the operation that failed.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: Opening a conversation keeps you at the newest message through the first history load. Scrolling back still preserves the message you are reading.

items.title: Keyboard layout
items.description: Chat adjusts the conversation above the keyboard as it opens and closes, while preserving your place when you are reading older messages.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: Chat keeps the newest message in view as a conversation opens and its layout settles.

items.title: Earlier messages
items.description: Older messages start loading sooner as you scroll up, while the message you are reading stays in place.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: On a fresh open, Chat keeps you at the latest message while earlier conversation history loads.

items.title: Message visibility
items.description: Sent prompts remain visible after reload, even when sender information is incomplete. Labels distinguish messages identified as yours.

items.title: Transcript notices
items.description: Connection and history updates now appear as quiet, bulleted captions alongside your conversation.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: The newest message stays in view when the keyboard or composer changes size, and after you send a message.

items.title: What's new
items.description: Chat now shows a one-time summary after an update, including releases you skipped.

items.title: Release notes
items.description: Type /settings to open Settings and browse notes for this and earlier releases.

items.title: Tool activity
items.description: See tool calls and session transitions in the conversation. Open a tool call to view its input and result.
